questions.question: After a shipwreck, how did the islanders of Malta show kindness to Paul and the others on a cold, rainy day?

answers.text: They kindled a fire and welcomed them all
They led them all to shelter in a cave
They handed out dry cloaks to everyone

questions.question: While Paul was laying sticks on a fire on Malta, which creature fastened itself to his hand?
On Malta, after waiting a long time and seeing nothing unusual happen to Paul, the islanders said he was a god. True or false?
When Paul visited the sick father of Publius on Malta, what did Paul do?

answers.text: He prayed and placed his hands on him
He anointed him with oil and left
He sent for the island's physician
